requirements.quotation: Format: 2–8 pages (excluding references) using the NeurIPS 2026 workshop template.
requirements.remediation: Obtain and hash NeurIPS 2026 workshop LaTeX template when URL resolves

requirements.quotation: Review process: Double-blind via OpenReview. Submissions must be fully anonymized.
requirements.remediation: Remove author-identifying GitHub URLs and git metadata from anonymous PDF; use OpenReview profile

requirements.quotation: Non-archival: Work may be submitted to or published at other venues concurrently.
Eligibility: Open to anyone who has not yet published at a top ML conference.
Excluding submissions that are not serious: blank pages, topics not in ML, papers not following format.
requirements.remediation: Template conformance check pending style zip capture

requirements.quotation: OpenReview profile must be up to date with publications and affiliations before submission.
requirements.remediation: Operator must verify OpenReview profile current; not automatable here
